tools.name: check_website
tools.description: Use when a public website will not load or you need a fresh server-side availability observation. Returns HTTP status, DNS answers, redirect chain, HTTPS connection evidence, timestamps and bounded retry attempts. Blocked or inconclusive is not proof of a global outage. No API key. API/MCP share cac

tools.name: get_service_status
tools.description: Read the latest scheduled homepage observation and up to 12 recent samples for a curated service. Includes freshness, scope and the official status link. Does not make a new request to the target website. Scheduled about every 15 minutes; stale after 35 minutes. Not an official or global outage repo

tools.name: list_monitored_services
tools.description: Discover curated service IDs, homepage URLs, measurement scopes and official status dashboards. No new website probe. Use get_service_status for existing observations or check_website for any public hostname.

tools.name: get_provider_incidents
tools.description: Use for official active incident reports from Claude, OpenAI, Google Cloud, Google Workspace, Google Search, Cloudflare, GitHub or Wikimedia. Returns affected components where reported, source links, updates, retrieval timestamps and explicit availability/staleness. Missing or stale data is unknown,

tools.name: investigate_incident
tools.description: Use when a public endpoint fails and you need evidence-based next steps. Combines one protected HTTP/DNS check, existing homepage history where supported, and optional official provider incidents. Provider is inferred only for known provider-owned hostnames; pass provider for a known dependency of a

tools.name: get_provider_components
tools.description: Use to distinguish Claude API/Claude Code, OpenAI Responses/Chat Completions and other listed components from a working homepage. Supported: Claude, OpenAI, Cloudflare, GitHub, Wikimedia. Optional component accepts an exact ID or case-insensitive name substring; no match is unknown, never operationa

tools.name: check_dns
tools.description: Use for public-domain DNS diagnosis: compare A/AAAA/CNAME/NS/MX/TXT/CAA records, TTL, DNS response codes and resolver-reported DNSSEC AD. One record type per call (default A), compared across two public recursive resolvers. Distinguishes NXDOMAIN, NOERROR without requested records, SERVFAIL, resolve

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_monitored_services, get_provider_components · Private data: check_website, get_provider_incidents, investigate_incident, get_provider_components, check_dns · Public sink: check_website.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_monitored_services, get_provider_components · Private data: check_website, get_provider_incidents, investigate_incident, get_provider_components, check_dns · Public sink: check_website

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
